purpose: One stable boot for fresh or parallel agents. Runtime compiles the smallest current work context and a cheap shared network so chats coordinate without the human relaying state.

hard_commands.Prometeo: RESYNC + RECOVER + CONTINUE: load current entry/manifest, infer the unfinished intent, route to one compiled packet, reconcile only relevant new deltas and continue.
CONTINUE CURRENT FRONTIER: compare tiny EPOCH; if unchanged continue immediately, if changed reload only the active compiled packet; never regenerate settled context/maps/specification.

freshness_rule: Already-bootstrapped chats read EPOCH before material work. Same epoch means no Network/Delta reread. New epoch means reload only the active compiled packet.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should be operating under Prometeo has no violet seal, send only `Prometeo` to force resync/recovery.

legacy_chat_rule: For an already-open chat that never learned Prometeo, send `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/p.txt` once. After that, `Prometeo` alone is recovery.
fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, fall back to NOW/PACK/LAST_RETURN/Git delta routing. Do not ask the human to reconstruct context until durable recovery paths have failed.
truth: Entry/runtime/network coordinate agents only; none grant Current, Served, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
